newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey gold refinery accord expected this week.
newsitem.headline: Turkey gold refinery accord expected this week.

text.p: An accord to establish Turkey's first gold refinery is to be signed this week with Australia's Gold Corporation, the general secretary of the Istanbul Gold Exchange (IAB) said.
The refinery is planned to begin operations by the beginning of 1998 at the latest, the IAB's Kaan Aytogu told Reuters.
He is to fly to Australia on Tuesday with the chairman of the Istanbul gold refinery company Altunc Kumova to sign the accord with representatives of Gold Corporation.
Aytogu said the Australian company is aiming to take a 35 percent stake in the venture, while the IAB aims to limit this stake to 25 percent.
The remaining stake will be held by the IAB and its members.
